# Barcelona Turisme

> > Official tourism platform for Barcelona, operated by Turisme de Barcelona, offering tickets, tours, and skip-the-line access to the city's museums, attractions, and activities.

Barcelona Turisme is the official tourism organization for Barcelona, managed by the Barcelona Consorci de Turisme. The platform serves as the primary booking channel for visitors seeking authentic Barcelona experiences, including tickets to iconic landmarks, guided tours, and cultural activities.

## Key Topics

- Barcelona
- Turisme de Barcelona
- Barcelona Consorci de Turisme
- Visit Barcelona Tickets
- Barcelona Convention Bureau
- Skip-the-line tickets
- Museums and attractions
- Guided tours
- Cultural activities
- Official tourism platform
- Ticket booking
- Tourism shop
- Barcelona experiences

## Official Ticket Shop

- [Barcelona Tickets: The Official Barcelona Tourism Store](https://bcnshop.barcelonaturisme.com/shopv3): Main Barcelona tourism ticket booking platform with skip-the-line access
- [Barcelona Tickets: Botiga oficial de Turisme de Barcelona](https://bcnshop.barcelonaturisme.com/shopv3/es): Official Barcelona tourism shop for tickets, tours & attractions
